summary: Time tracking and invoicing software for teams and freelancers.
access_note: Personal Access Token created in Harvest ID developer section; OAuth2 apps for multi-user integrations.

evidence.quote: Personal Access Tokens are the preferred method when you want to write your own scripts that consume our API.
If you are interested in building integrations that other users can use, you will need to register an OAuth2 Application
The API can be accessed by creating a Personal Access Token from the Developers section of Harvest ID.
Free Built for individual freelancers starting from $0 forever
The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.

notes: Harvest's MCP support article (support.getharvest.com/hc/en-us/articles/46293697226381-Harvest-MCP) is blocked to scripts, so the mcp quote comes from the vendor's own OAuth protected-resource metadata at api.harvestapp.com, which names the /mcp resource; search snippets of the help article confirm it is the official remote MCP using OAuth. Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) exists; API availability on it is not stated on a fetched page.

review.reason: Original page refused script access, so the quote could not be checked.
MCP evidence is indirect and free-plan API access is inferred.
